description: This file is a report script for a manufacturing job card summary in an ERPNext system. It defines functions to fetch, process, and visualize job card data, including generating chart data for reporting. The script interacts with the database through Frappe framework calls, filters data by date and status, and provides structured output for rendering reports and charts.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for the report, returns columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data(filters)
methods.description: Fetches detailed job card data, including filtering, status updates, and time logs.

methods.name: get_chart_data(job_card_details, filters)
methods.description: Generates chart data showing open vs completed job cards over periods.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data(job_card_details, filters)
methods.description: Prepares period labels and aggregates job card statuses over time ranges.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Defines the columns structure for the report display.
